reviews.comment: Worst professor I've come across in along time. Lectures aren't helpful and she seemed unprepared every class. She doesn't know whats even on her slides half the time. Slides are minimum and belong in middle school. Bulk of grade comes from exams. She removed a 50 point presentation required by the curriculum so grades weighed even more on exams.

Not too bad of a class. Lectures can be boring but overall and interesting topic. Her quizzes and test are not just based on the slides but it's based off of what she says. I recommend attending class, taking good notes and active listening. Also sit in the front of the room because she doesn't always use a mic.

I don't understand any of the bad reviews on here, she's a great professor with interesting lectures and her exams are easy if you just show up to class and take notes, minimal studying required. The weekly quizzes are even open note, don't blame the professor for your own problems.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR!She literally talks about the most random things most of class,and her lectures are all over the place. All the quizzes for the class are on Thursdays and add up to the value of a test. She took out the project and made everything weigh more halfway through the semester, when we were already failing her tests. NEVER AGAIN
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's lowk not as bad as the reviews make her seem. I mean the other anthro teachers make the class way easier by a milestone, but as long as you show up, listen, and take notes, you'll probably get an easy A.

Very simple professor and runs her class that way. Only 15 assignments all year (3 tests and 12 quizzes which were every Thursday). Super light hearted and lights to keep the class engaged. 10 out of 10 would recommend.

I have no idea why there are so many bad reviews. Professor Athreya is great. Her lectures are fun and interesting. We had weekly open note quizzes. She didn't like any anthropology textbooks so she gave us weekly pdfs for us to read so we wouldn't have to buy a textbook. I love this class. Try to sit in the front, she isn't great with microphones.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a little disorganized but she's very helpful and kind, her lectures are interesting and very engaging. If you don't take good notes then you won't do well in the class, and your grade mostly consists of 3 exams and a project. Overall, enjoyable class and relatively easy.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's a great professor, when she saw that the class was struggling during the first exam - she let us use our notice for the next exams. I didn't even buy the textbook and still did good. The only issue is you only have 3 grades so if you mess up the first exam you won't make an A. However, she did allow us to use notes and gave extra credit.

She is not flexible, very condescending toward you, and speaks to you as if you are nothing. She is a major feminist and everything is feminism. She will not round your grade at all. You are better off taking something else, even if this is a prereq. Take it at a community college.

Dr. Athreya is not a very good professor. She uses outdated lectures, often has recording issues, and can get off topic easily. 90% of your grade will be exam. Dr. Athreya and the TA Missy are not very accessible whatsoever. The entire course is poorly set up and extremely unorganized. Good luck!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: She makes you purchase a very expensive textbook for a class that in all honesty, people just take  becasue it is a pre-req for graduation. She makes her class hard on purpose like not allowing access to her low effort precorded lectures after the week that she uploads them, for no real reason besides wanting to make peoples' live difficult.

Non accessible at all during the semester despite her lectures being recorded. She ignores her emails. She really does not care about the student and has low self esteem about her career and herself. Cares more about everyone becoming the perfect anthropologist rather than helping students learn anything in her class.

Anyone who thought this would be an easy course, or had interesting material is wrong because she makes her class hard since she is insecure about anthropology not being considered a serious topic by others. I am taking a higher level anth 210 course and its easier and I learn more there. She is also much more busy than an engineering prof .
Make sure to listen to lectures for the test will be mostly from her recorded lectures. Also it was hard to contact her for some reason. TA was not helpful, mostly does the work for the class.

This is the worst class and she is the worst professor.   DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!   I  have As in all of my classes except for this class.   The median passing grade as of today is a 68% out of 75 online students.

reviews.comment: Each week, expect to read 1-3 textbook chapters, read 1-3 journal articles, read 1-3 website pages, and watch awful lectures that force you to re-watch them since she leaves mistakes in her clips, and uses the most confusing language to explain any topic she teaches known to man. She closes her lectures if you don't, and she is inaccessible always.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This is the worst professor I have ever encountered. I pay to take this course but she closes the modules each week. She patronizes students for asking questions, overloads us with information, lectures and readings and does not believe in reviews or helping students prepare for exams. Never have I regretted taking a class as much as I do this one.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She posted lectures. I asked to see if I could go over a few questions with her and she asked me to ask the TA- like it wasn't her literal JOB.
She can win as many awards as possible at TAMU but it won't make her any better of a professor.

There's an old review on here that says "this professor is intellectually insecure and does not respond well when students challenge or question her." That is her in a nutshell. Went to her office hours once- never went back. She was extremely condescending and its like it HURT her to do her job. She was unwilling to meet students half way.

Worst thing is that she closes modules a couple days before the exams, which is bs because I'm paying for the course, so why should my access to material ever be taken away in the first place. I understand maybe cutting access to material for previous exams but she'll fully cut off access to all material before the exam that we are being tested on.

ABSOLUTELY AVOID AT ALL COST. this is an intro level course and she makes it unnecessarily difficult. Entire class failed both exams, not polite, closes modules after 7 days, barely lets you see modules again before exam, not accessible out of class neither was her TA, literal worst professor i have ever had in my life.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE! This was one of the most awful professors i have ever experienced, both her and her ta were extremely unaccessible and not always nice in responses, First exam the entire class failed horribly barely improved on second, only leaves her modules open for a week and barely lets you look at them before exam, only 3 exam grades

reviews.comment: SO DIFFICULT FOR NO REASON. She expects hours to be spent on this online class when, most of the time, people are just taking it for a general ed credit. Personally, I do not have the time to spend hours reading and studying for tests when I have more important classes to dedicate my time to. She obviously did not have a social life in college.

As someone who is taking this ONLINE class as general education credit, it is unnecessarily hard. DO NOT TAKE HER! The exams are pretty much the only grades in the class and cover mostly the lectures that are long and boring. She releases new modules every week and takes them down after only one week, so it is vital you do not fall behind.
No not TAKE.  She only gives 3 exams.   No extra credit.   Highest passing grade in class is a D.

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HER CLASS! It's so annoying the way she makes the exams and nobody passes them! She constantly takes away the modules for the exam a week before the exam, so if you want to do a quick review then you're screwed! The set up for the exams are a mess, the way she has time limit for out studying is a mess, and overall just don't take!

If not needed do not take. You will have a week to view material for that week so if you miss it then you don't get the notes for it. Only have 3 grades that go in and those are the 3 exams. Exams go over at 7 chapters and the style of question varies. Honestly it stressed me out and I would not take another one of her classes.

Terrible. She will close modules every week so that you only have a set time to go over material. She will lock ALL lecture videos days before the exam so that you cannot possibly study for the exam. People have requested that she keep the modules open and she refused. Exams are very lecture heavy, which is why this is a HUGE problem. Do not take.

This class shouldn't be a difficult one but she insists that modules should be closed off after the week ends which seems ridiculous. If you want me to be successful don't limit my ability to revisit material, this seems like I'm paying full price for a course but only have access to a small small portion of what I paid for.

Bases her exams purely on her lecture notes that are barely related to the book.She speaks very fast in class&expects everyone to catch up &take notes,making it difficult for students to catch up at home with the course. She's very difficult to talk too as shes very unapproachable &harsh, is definitely not lenient & doesn't care about her students
All exams are lecture based so you better go to class or you'll probably receive a poor garde.

reviews.comment: Dr. Athreya is an excellent professor. Yes, this class was difficult at first, but once you get the hang of taking notes, it becomes easier. I truly enjoyed this class and am planning on taking another course with her.

I got an A in this class. Best advice is to go to class everyday, try and keep up with the notes (she talks fast) but she lets you tape the class, DO THIS! I relistened to the lectures which was really helpful when studying. Its a lot of material but if you put the studying in you should be fine. I really liked the class.

I agree with all the comments displayed. She talks too fast, gets distracted, talks about irrelevant stuff, contradicts herself, confuses herself, and horrible exams. This is one of the hardest classes I have taken (I am a junior). You will regret taking it, DO NOT TAKE IT. DO NOT TAKE IT. DO NOT TAKE IT.

She speaks super fast and will not slow down at all. No technology is allowed at all. She is insecure, cold, and easily distracted. Often she tells us things about her personal life that have no correlation to the material. When lecturing she will often give wrong information and then have to correct herself later.

This professor is intellectually insecure and does not respond well when students challenge or question her. She often said one thing and then said something very different later in lecture. Her grading system is subjective and it is likely your grade will not be an accurate reflection of your work.
I have never had to work so hard in my life. Very demanding professor. She is great one-on-one, but can be very very cold and short-tempered in a classroom setting.
